reviews.text:
I had multiple bids to resurface my pool. I was so impressed with the initial conversation, I ended up choosing Plaster People.  And now that the work has been completed, I could not be happier.
Product is clean, looks and feels good. Thy found good ways to save me money in the process, and were amazing to work with.
Thank you Plaster People, it was a great experience for me and my checkbook!
reviews.author: Nick Walters

reviews.text: Our pool desperately needed an update as well as a pool leak repaired.  We are extremely happy with the workmanship and results are fabulous.  I highly recommend Juan Huerta and his company Plaster People LLC
reviews.author: Jan McNerney

reviews.text: Juan was awesome! Completed the work fast and kept me posted on progress. He responded to any issues very fast and delivered the remodel on time.
reviews.author: Sankha NagChoudhury

reviews.text: Prompt, friendly, knowledgeable and very communicative. They have taken a huge load off of my shoulders by taking on our pool  service.  10/10 would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: aaron riggs

reviews.text: Juan and his entire team did an outstanding job with the Plaster, Tile, Coping and Stone Work!! We would highly recommend them for any pool project!
reviews.author: John Ehlert

reviews.text:
Been using their services to have my pool cleaned for a while now.

No matter if there is a tear in the filter, sand storm came through or it’s fall time and the pool is filled with leaves, Juan always comes in with a smile and gets the, what seems to be an impossible job, done right away!
reviews.author: Ruben S

reviews.text: I can enjoy my pool worry-free, knowing it’s in the best hands. I highly recommend plaster people  to anyone looking for top-notch pool cleaning and maintenance service's ❤️❤️
reviews.author: Nishma Bohora

reviews.text: I’ve been working with Plaster People for a year and would highly recommend. Very professional and punctual!
reviews.author: Trinh Nguyen
